items.title: Implement the canonical verifier-derived coverage basis and bounded classification
items.context: Add complete/partial/unsupported basis semantics without any caller-writable path inventory or optimistic completeness. Reuse Wave 1 ownership and existing process-fact interfaces.
items.userSees: `lattice acceptance_basis --storyId=<id> --json` reports a verifier-derived `basisStatus` of `complete`, `partial`, or `unsupported`; no request field can force `complete`.

items.title: Implement registered discovery adapters and deterministic union reconciliation
items.context: Discover producer-consumer plus handler/dispatch/static/runtime paths through typed adapters; disagreement, omitted required adapters, and unsupported profiles fail to partial or unsupported.
items.userSees: The basis report lists every required discovery adapter and its digest; omitted adapters or unexplained static/runtime and handler/dispatch disagreement return `partial` with stable diagnostics.

items.title: Bind signed basis receipts to workspace, scope, topology and closure identities
items.context: Persist only verifier-issued hash-bound receipts with basis/topology/scope/storyFilesHash/closureFilesHash bindings and canonical freshness checks; prohibit hash-only rebinds.
items.userSees: A successful verifier run writes a signed receipt bound to the exact workspace, scope, topology, Story and closure hashes; a stale or tampered receipt is rejected rather than rebound.

items.title: Reconcile frozen planned declarations and independently approved exclusions
items.context: Derive typed planned paths from verificationIntent declarations and scope, allow genuinely new PLAN endpoints, require eligible decision refs for exclusions, and fail unexplained planned-to-actual drift.
items.userSees: Frozen verification-intent planned paths appear in the independently derived PLAN basis, while invented topology paths and exclusions without an eligible decision reference produce deterministic diagnostics.

items.title: Expose read-only basis diagnostics and prove omission and tamper resistance
items.context: Add deterministic read-only rendering, process-fact registration/contract coverage, legacy behavior, replayable adapter results, and positive/negative mutation tests covering omission, disagreement, stale binding and tampering.
items.userSees: The focused Wave 1A smoke prints `ProofStory acceptance coverage basis Wave 1A smoke passed`; omission, disagreement, stale-binding and tamper mutations fail before the restored control passes.
